cause: A local close can be confused with document teardown or global writer transfer
rule: M04 owns document/discard; facade only revokes exact derived attachment. Cross-window authority not inferred.

cause: An ACK may complete after a UI view closes
rule: Do not roll back committed effects or call formal ACK from close. Separate issuer evidence from delivery.

cause: Fixture tombstones can silently invent production retry guarantees
rule: No request_id, no TTL, capacity and missing/alreadyclosed decisions explicit pending Owner.
